title: Blog Post Writer
description: Write engaging, well-structured, and informative blog posts on any topic.
prompt: Act as a professional content writer. Write a high-quality blog post about [TOPIC]. Make it engaging, well-structured with headings, and between 800-1200 words. Include an introduction, main body, and conclusion. Use a [TONE] tone.

title: Copywriting Expert
description: Create persuasive sales copy that converts readers into customers.
prompt: Act as an expert copywriter. Write persuasive sales copy for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE]. Focus on benefits, address pain points, and include a strong call to action. Use the [STYLE] style (e.g., AIDA, PAS).

title: Social Media Content Creator
description: Generate creative and engaging posts for different social media platforms.
prompt: Act as a social media content specialist. Create 5 engaging posts for [PLATFORM] about [TOPIC OR BRAND]. Include captions, relevant hashtags, and suggestions for visuals. Match the platform’s style and audience.

title: Email Writer
description: Write professional, clear, and effective emails for various purposes.
prompt: Act as a professional email writing expert. Write a [TYPE OF EMAIL] email (e.g., cold outreach, follow-up, newsletter, apology). Make it clear, concise, and appropriate for [AUDIENCE]. Subject line: [SUBJECT].

title: Storytelling Coach
description: Craft compelling stories that capture attention and evoke emotion.
prompt: Act as a master storyteller. Write a compelling short story or narrative based on [THEME OR IDEA]. Focus on strong characters, emotional impact, and a satisfying structure. Length: [WORD COUNT].

title: Content Editor & Improver
description: Edit and improve existing content for clarity, flow, grammar, and impact.
prompt: Act as a professional editor. Improve the following text by fixing grammar, enhancing clarity, improving flow, and making it more engaging. Keep the original meaning: [TEXT]

title: SEO Content Writer
description: Write SEO-optimized content that ranks well and provides value to readers.
prompt: Act as an SEO content specialist. Write an SEO-optimized article about [TOPIC] targeting the keyword [KEYWORD]. Include proper headings, meta description suggestion, and natural keyword usage. Aim for [WORD COUNT] words.

title: Product Description Writer
description: Create compelling and conversion-focused product descriptions.
prompt: Act as an e-commerce copywriter. Write a persuasive product description for [PRODUCT]. Highlight key features, benefits, and unique selling points. Make it appealing for [TARGET AUDIENCE] and include a call to action.

title: Script Writer
description: Write scripts for videos, podcasts, presentations, or YouTube content.
prompt: Act as a professional scriptwriter. Write a script for a [TYPE OF CONTENT] (e.g., YouTube video, podcast intro, presentation) about [TOPIC]. Include an engaging hook, main content, and a strong ending. Duration: approximately [MINUTES] minutes.

title: Tone & Style Adapter
description: Rewrite any text in a different tone, style, or for a different audience.
prompt: Act as a versatile writing expert. Rewrite the following text in a [NEW TONE OR STYLE] tone (e.g., professional, casual, humorous, formal) suitable for [AUDIENCE]: [TEXT]
